notes.title: Troop tether beam, achievements, major balance changes, terrain regrowth
notes.content:
New Features

     Troop tether beam (activated when holding down COMMAND instruction).
     16 Achievements added.
     Golem artifact re-introduced.
     Terrain now regrows after a delay.
     Mine count indicator now shows total mines in a map.


Bug Fixes


     Fixed issue where upgrading a Hero at research displayed the incorrect message: "Upgrade building lvl complete."
     Weapons now level up every 4 Hero levels instead of every 5.
     Fixed Scientist Mole equipping the wrong weapon—now correctly uses the DEPLOYER.
     Addressed issue where Research Center wouldn't open if originally built without power.
     Fixed radial BUILDINGS description disappearing under certain conditions.
     Golem artifact remnant no longer remains after pickup.
     Fixed Mole turrets (mortar) retaining power after moving too far from the base.
     Add missing power-up/down sound for Research stations.


Balance Changes

     Slightly increased Power Range to prevent turrets from powering down when built at the edge of influence.
     Increased Human Infirmary range to 11 and slightly boosted base heal amount.
     Adjusted Mole Mine HP from 400 → 250.
     Railgun Damage increased from 54 → 58.
     Rocket Damage Adjustments:
         Direct hit: 12 → 14
         Explosion damage: 16 → 19
         Slightly increased explosion radius.
     Greatly lowered the cost of upgrading with Reconstructor.
     Gates are now buildable within enemy radius.
     Added troop tether beam so that players have greater control over troop movement.


Gameplay & AI Improvements


     Campaign Mode: Players now retain half of their match resources as campaign resources.
     Research upgrades for Heroes in Campaign/Endless Mode now apply to all player Heroes (when playing w/ 2+ users).
     Endless Mode Fixes & Adjustments:
         Terrain regrowth timer now resets properly.
         Bosses now spawn every 3 levels instead of every level.
         Implemented enemy/boss cap when retreating to prevent performance issues.
         Fixed issue where Golem could fall off the map when advancing.
     Golem now correctly spawns at the current HQ spawn point (unless the latest HQ was destroyed).
     Buildings will now attempt to re-snap themselves to a parent building when disconnected / falling.


UI & Quality of Life Improvements

     Updated Mole Grunt description: no longer uses a pickaxe to dig.
     Remove messages about Deployable Turrets (under attack/destroyed notifications removed).
     Main console screen now resets to Step 1 after ending a match (if not in Campaign).

notes.title: Update Notes for 8/29/2023
notes.content:
Increase speed for all cycles and strengthen their wheel suspension & gyro behavior.
 Further randomize the position of resource hotspots underground in Survival mode.
 Adjust trader spawn position.
 Hotfix for issue in scrollable lists not following selection when switching between mouse+keyboard to gamepad controls.

notes.title: Update notes for 8/26/2023
notes.content:
Allow P1 to seamlessly switch between using different controllers or keyboard/mouse (instead of joining a new player).
 Add a new toggle in the "PLAYERS" tab to enable other players to join (since the new behavior above would prevent that essentially).
 Fix an issue with targeting accuracy of the radial build menu for keyboard/mouse players when in split screen.
 Fix text styling on small elements in certain languages.

notes.title: Command Heroes is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
The day is finally here, but this is just the beginning.

What a journey.  As some of you may know, this was a solo project with the help of 2 very talented friends along the way.

How to Play:
You can find a "How to Play" section within the game, in the "GAME" tab of the pause menu.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41141028/aa28d35c9b54ffe7ea1e3a7436c461bc4b03ad21.jpg


What to Play:
The various game modes give a different experience.  I suggest experimenting with settings on "Custom" mode, including setting the spawn for your team in the middle of enemy AI teams once you are familiar with the game mechanics, and later making the enemy AI's on the same team vs you instead of a free-for-all.  
In Custom mode, there are no "edges" to the map, instead it wraps around in a sort of non-Euclidean geometry.  If you walk across the far left edge, you will be teleported to the right edge of the map and vice-versa.

Campaign mode is playable, but still a work in progress, expect huge changes to that mode.

Endless and Survival modes challenge you with increasingly more difficult enemies, and you must keep pace by acquiring powerful artifacts and leveling up your hero or you will be left behind.  In these modes you can become extremely powerful, soaring across the map and taking on massive hordes which were previously impossible.


Help me help you:
I am listening to feedback, and the game will experience radical transformations now that there are many more eyes on it.
Join our discord, message me on Twitter, start a Discussion on Steam, email me, contact via our website;
whatever form of communication you prefer.  I will get the message and respond.

notes.title: Capture the Flag Mode
notes.content:
This update adds Research Centers, artillery turrets, crouching, new units, dozens of new weapons, on top of an entirely new game mode: Capture the Flag.  After release, I will make more regular updates where I can go into detail into every item.  For now, it is way too much for this post.

Neumann

Health: 140
Speed: 11

Obsessed with blowing things up, after losing his legs due to a lab accident, he replicated the dozer track design for use on citizens.

Major has dual revolvers which feels extremely satisfying, and makes him lethal at medium range.

Anna

notes.title: Campaign Mode
notes.content:
Campaign mode is here! Hop around the cosmos gathering gear, mining some sweet resources, and paying off your debt (or maybe you have other motives?).

Your crew is everything. Keep them alive and you might be able to endure. Difficult and unforgiving, you will live or die by your choices so choose wisely.
